# =============================================================================
# RICE Configuration: CAGE Challenge 2 (Cybersecurity Defense)
# =============================================================================
# Based on the Cardiff champion scheme from:
#   https://github.com/john-cardiff/-cyborg-cage-2
#
# Blue agent defends a network of hosts against a red agent following the
# "B-line" attack strategy. The environment is evaluated across trail lengths
# {30, 50, 100} with the final reward being the average across lengths.
#
# Reference: RICE paper Table 3, Appendix C.3
# =============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
env:
  id: "Cage2-v0"                     # Gymnasium environment ID
  state_dim: 52                       # Observation vector: host status, services, decoys, red progress, etc.
  action_dim: 11                      # 11 discrete blue actions (Monitor, Analyze, DecoyApache, ..., Remove, Restore)
  is_discrete: true                   # Discrete action space
  max_episode_steps: 100              # Max steps per episode
  trail_length: 50                    # Default trail length (also evaluated at 30, 100)
  num_hosts: 5                        # Number of hosts in the network
  render_mode: null                   # No rendering by default

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target agent (PPO) pre-training hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_agent:
  algorithm: "PPO"                    # Proximal Policy Optimization
  policy: "MlpPolicy"                 # MLP policy network
  learning_rate: 3.0e-4               # Learning rate (Stable-Baselines3 default)
  n_steps: 2048                       # Steps per PPO update
  batch_size: 64                      # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                        # Number of epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                         # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                    # GAE lambda
  clip_range: 0.2                     # PPO clipping parameter
  ent_coef: 0.01                      # Entropy coefficient (higher for discrete actions)
  vf_coef: 0.5                        # Value function coefficient
  max_grad_norm: 0.5                  # Gradient clipping
  net_arch:
    pi: [256, 256]                    # Policy network: 2 hidden layers of 256 units
    vf: [256, 256]                    # Value network: 2 hidden layers of 256 units
  activation_fn: "ReLU"               # Activation function
  total_timesteps: 5_000_000          # Total pre-training steps (CAGE requires more samples)
  use_sde: false                      # No State-Dependent Exploration

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mask network architecture and training
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mask_net:
  hidden_dim: 256                     # Hidden layer size
  num_layers: 2                       # Number of hidden layers
  activation: "ReLU"                  # Activation function
  output_dim: 2                       # 2 outputs: [keep, blind]
  alpha: 0.0001                       # Intrinsic reward coefficient for blinding (Table 3)
  learning_rate: 3.0e-4               # PPO learning rate for mask training
  n_steps: 2048                       # Steps per update
  batch_size: 64                      # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                        # Epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                         # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                    # GAE lambda
  clip_range: 0.2                     # PPO clipping
  ent_coef: 0.01                      # Entropy coefficient
  total_timesteps: 10_000_000         # Mask training steps (Table 4: 1e7 for CAGE)
  eval_freq: 50000                    # Evaluation frequency during training

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Explanation / critical state identification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
explanation:
  importance_method: "mask_prob"      # I(s) = 1 - xi(s) (probability of blinding)
  top_k: 1                            # Store top-1 most critical state per trajectory
  min_importance_threshold: 0.0       # No minimum threshold (store all)
  buffer_size: 10000                  # Critical state buffer capacity

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Random Network Distillation (RND) exploration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rnd:
  embedding_dim: 128                  # Output dimension of target/predictor networks
  hidden_dim: 256                     # Hidden layer size for RND networks
  num_layers: 2                       # Number of hidden layers
  learning_rate: 1.0e-3               # Predictor learning rate (Adam)
  obs_norm_decay: 0.99                # Running mean/std decay for bonus normalization
  gradient_clip: 10.0                 # Gradient clipping for predictor updates

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Refining loop hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
refining:
  p: 0.5                              # Probability of resetting to critical state (Table 3)
  lambda_coef: 0.01                   # RND exploration bonus coefficient (Table 3)
  beta: 0.5                           # Initial distribution mixing (default)
  total_timesteps: 2_000_000          # Total refining steps (CAGE may need more)
  learning_rate: 3.0e-5               # Lower LR for fine-tuning during refining
  n_steps: 2048                       # Steps per PPO update
  batch_size: 64                      # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                        # Epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                         # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                    # GAE lambda
  clip_range: 0.2                     # PPO clipping
  ent_coef: 0.01                      # Entropy coefficient
  vf_coef: 0.5                        # Value function coefficient
  max_grad_norm: 0.5                  # Gradient clipping
  buffer_refresh_freq: 50000          # Refresh critical state buffer every N steps
  buffer_refresh_episodes: 50         # Number of episodes to collect for buffer refresh
  eval_freq: 50000                    # Evaluation frequency
  n_eval_episodes: 30                 # Evaluation episodes (average over trail lengths)
  save_best: true                     # Save best model during refining

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline comparison methods
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
baselines:
  statemask:
    sparsity_coef: 0.0001             # Sparsity penalty (negative alpha)
    mask_training_timesteps: 10_000_000  # Same as RICE mask training
    mask_hidden_dim: 256
    mask_num_layers: 2
    mask_lr: 3.0e-4
    total_refine_timesteps: 2_000_000
    p_mixed: 0.5
    lambda_coef: 0.01

  jsrl:
    guide_horizon: 30                 # Guide policy runs for 30 steps (shorter trails)
    p_jsrl: 0.5                       # Probability of using guide
    total_timesteps: 2_000_000
    learning_rate: 3.0e-4

  sil:
    sil_weight: 0.1                   # SIL loss weight
    sil_batch_size: 512               # SIL batch size
    sil_buffer_capacity: 100000       # SIL replay buffer capacity
    sil_value_clip: null              # No value clipping
    sil_entropy_coef: 0.0             # No entropy bonus in SIL loss
    total_timesteps: 2_000_000
    learning_rate: 3.0e-5
    buffer_population_episodes: 100   # Episodes to populate SIL buffer

  ppo_finetune:
    total_timesteps: 2_000_000
    learning_rate: 3.0e-5             # Reduced LR for fine-tuning

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Experiment settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
experiment:
  seed: 42                            # Random seed for reproducibility
  device: "auto"                      # "auto", "cuda", or "cpu"
  n_eval_episodes: 30                 # Evaluation episodes per trail length
  trail_lengths: [30, 50, 100]        # Trail lengths for evaluation (paper: average across these)
  save_dir: "results/cage2"           # Directory for saving results
  log_dir: "logs/cage2"               # Directory for logs
  model_dir: "models/cage2"           # Directory for saving model checkpoints
  verbose: 1                          # Verbosity level (0=silent, 1=info, 2=debug)

# =============================================================================
# Notes:
# - CAGE Challenge 2 uses the champion scheme from Cardiff.
# - The red agent follows "B-line" deterministic attack pattern.
# - Evaluation averages returns across trail lengths {30, 50, 100}.
# - Negative reward when red gains admin access.
# - Mask training requires 1e7 steps due to environment complexity.
# - Refining uses p=0.5 (50% critical state resets) and lambda=0.01.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# RICE Configuration: Selfish Mining Environment
# =============================================================================
# Based on Bar-Zur et al. (2023) selfish mining formulation.
# Paper reference: Table 3, Table 4, Appendix C.3
# =============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
env:
  id: "SelfishMining-v0"           # Registered Gymnasium environment ID
  sparse: false                     # Not applicable (discrete game)
  state_dim: 4                      # [selfish_chain_len, honest_chain_len, 
                                    #  selfish_orphan_len, mempool_fee]
  action_dim: 3                     # Adopt (0), Reveal (1), Mine (2)
  is_discrete: true                 # Discrete action space
  max_episode_steps: 200            # Maximum steps per episode
  render_mode: null                 # No rendering for this env
  # Selfish mining specific parameters
  honest_rate: 0.6                  # Honest network mining rate
  selfish_rate: 0.4                 # Selfish miner mining rate
  whale_prob: 0.01                  # Probability of whale transaction
  whale_fee: 10.0                   # Whale transaction fee
  normal_fee: 1.0                   # Normal transaction fee
  block_reward: 1.0                 # Base block reward
  max_chain_len: 100                # Maximum chain length

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target agent (PPO) pre-training hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_agent:
  algorithm: "PPO"                  # Proximal Policy Optimization
  policy: "MlpPolicy"               # MLP policy network
  learning_rate: 3.0e-4             # Learning rate for Adam optimizer
  n_steps: 2048                     # Steps per PPO update
  batch_size: 64                    # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                      # Number of epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                       # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                  # GAE lambda parameter
  clip_range: 0.2                   # PPO clipping parameter
  clip_range_vf: null               # Value function clipping (null = no clipping)
  normalize_advantage: true         # Advantage normalization
  ent_coef: 0.0                     # Entropy coefficient
  vf_coef: 0.5                      # Value function coefficient
  max_grad_norm: 0.5                # Gradient clipping
  use_sde: false                    # State-dependent exploration
  sde_sample_freq: -1               # SDE sampling frequency
  target_kl: null                   # Target KL divergence (null = no early stopping)
  # Network architecture (4-layer MLP as per paper)
  policy_kwargs:
    net_arch:
      pi: [128, 128, 128, 128]      # Policy network: 4 hidden layers of 128
      vf: [128, 128, 128, 128]      # Value network: 4 hidden layers of 128
    activation_fn: "ReLU"           # ReLU activation
  total_timesteps: 2_000_000        # Total pre-training environment steps
  verbose: 1                        # Logging verbosity
  seed: null                        # Will be set by experiment script

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mask network architecture and training hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mask_net:
  hidden_dim: 256                   # Hidden layer dimension
  num_layers: 2                     # Number of hidden layers
  activation: "ReLU"                # Activation function
  output_dim: 2                     # 2 outputs: [keep, blind]
  alpha: 0.0001                     # Intrinsic reward coefficient for blinding
                                    # (Table 3: α = 0.0001 for all environments)
  learning_rate: 3.0e-4             # PPO learning rate for mask training
  n_steps: 2048                     # Steps per PPO update
  batch_size: 64                    # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                      # Number of epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                       # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                  # GAE lambda
  clip_range: 0.2                   # PPO clipping
  ent_coef: 0.01                    # Entropy coefficient (encourages exploration)
  total_timesteps: 1_500_000        # Mask training steps (Table 4: 1.5e6 for Selfish)
  eval_freq: 50000                  # Evaluation frequency during training
  n_eval_episodes: 20               # Episodes per evaluation

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Explanation / critical state identification settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
explanation:
  importance_method: "mask_prob"    # Method: "mask_prob", "logit_diff", "softmax_diff"
  top_k: 1                          # Number of critical states per trajectory
  min_importance_threshold: 0.0     # Minimum importance to consider a state critical
  buffer_size: 10000                # Maximum size of critical state buffer

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Random Network Distillation (RND) hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rnd:
  embedding_dim: 128                # Output dimension of target/predictor networks
  hidden_dim: 256                   # Hidden layer dimension
  num_layers: 2                     # Number of hidden layers
  learning_rate: 1.0e-3             # Predictor learning rate (Adam)
  obs_norm_decay: 0.99              # Running mean/std decay for bonus normalization
  gradient_clip_norm: 10.0          # Gradient clipping for predictor updates

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Refining loop hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
refining:
  p: 0.5                            # Mixture probability: P(s_0 ~ D_crit)
                                    # (Table 3: p = 0.5 for Selfish Mining)
  lambda_coef: 0.01                 # RND exploration bonus coefficient λ
                                    # (Table 3: λ = 0.01 for Selfish Mining)
  beta: 0.5                         # Initial distribution mixing (default)
  total_timesteps: 1_000_000        # Total refining environment steps
  learning_rate: 3.0e-5             # Lower LR for fine-tuning during refining
  n_steps: 2048                     # Steps per PPO update
  batch_size: 64                    # Mini-batch size
  n_epochs: 10                      # Number of epochs per update
  gamma: 0.99                       # Discount factor
  gae_lambda: 0.95                  # GAE lambda
  clip_range: 0.2                   # PPO clipping
  ent_coef: 0.0                     # Entropy coefficient
  vf_coef: 0.5                      # Value function coefficient
  max_grad_norm: 0.5                # Gradient clipping
  # Buffer refresh settings
  buffer_refresh_freq: 50000        # Steps between buffer refreshes
  buffer_refresh_episodes: 50       # Number of episodes per refresh
  # Evaluation during refining
  eval_freq: 50000                  # Evaluation frequency
  n_eval_episodes: 50               # Episodes per evaluation
  save_best: true                   # Save best model during training

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline comparison hyperparameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
baselines:
  # StateMask baseline
  statemask:
    sparsity_coef: 0.0001           # Sparsity penalty (negative alpha)
    mask_training_timesteps: 1_500_000  # Same as RICE mask training
    mask_hidden_dim: 256
    mask_num_layers: 2
    mask_lr: 3.0e-4
    total_refine_timesteps: 1_000_000
    p_mixed: 0.5
    lambda_coef: 0.01
    refine_learning_rate: 3.0e-5

  # Jump-Start RL baseline
  jsrl:
    guide_horizon: 50               # Steps guided by guide policy
    p_jsrl: 0.5                     # Probability of using JSRL reset
    total_timesteps: 1_000_000
    learning_rate: 3.0e-4

  # Self-Imitation Learning baseline
  sil:
    sil_weight: 0.1                 # Weight of SIL loss in combined objective
    sil_batch_size: 512             # Batch size for SIL updates
    sil_buffer_capacity: 100000     # Replay buffer capacity
    sil_value_clip: null            # Value clipping for SIL (null = no clipping)
    sil_entropy_coef: 0.0           # Entropy coefficient for SIL
    total_timesteps: 1_000_000
    learning_rate: 3.0e-5
    buffer_population_episodes: 100 # Episodes to populate SIL buffer

  # PPO fine-tuning baseline
  ppo_finetune:
    learning_rate: 3.0e-5           # Reduced learning rate for fine-tuning
    total_timesteps: 1_000_000

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Experiment settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
experiment:
  seed: 42                          # Random seed for reproducibility
  device: "auto"                    # Device: "auto", "cpu", "cuda"
  n_eval_episodes: 100              # Episodes for final evaluation
  eval_deterministic: true          # Use deterministic policy for evaluation
  # Save and logging
  save_dir: "results/selfish_mining"
  log_dir: "logs/selfish_mining"
  model_dir: "models/selfish_mining"
  verbose: 1                        # Logging verbosity (0=silent, 1=info, 2=debug)
